fields.name: providerId
fields.label: OIDC provider ID
fields.note: Enter the OIDC provider ID linked to your Vultr OAuth application.

fields.name: authorizationEndpoint
fields.label: Authorization endpoint
fields.note: Copy authorization_endpoint from the provider's OpenID configuration. Use the Vultr authorization URL, not the token URL.

config.hint: Register the Foundation callback URL on your Vultr OAuth application and attach the required permission policies. Draft applications can be authorized by allowlisted users; public applications require Vultr approval. Uses PKCE and renews access with rotating refresh tokens.

fields.name: token
fields.label: API key
fields.note: Use an API key with the permissions you need. For automation, you can use a service user's key. If API access is limited by IP, allow the machine that will call the API.

config.hint: Use VULTR_API_KEY with the Vultr CLI or as a Bearer token for the Vultr v2 API. Human and service-user API keys use this same authentication method.
